annotations.title: Robots.txt check: may this crawler fetch this URL?

description: Read a site's robots.txt and say whether a crawler may fetch a URL, by RFC 9309 rules as Google applies them (most specific user-agent group, longest matching Allow or Disallow, Allow on ties, * and $ wildcards). Returns the deciding rule, the group used, the rule count and the sitemaps listed. A missing robots.txt (4xx) allows everything. Use before scraping or crawling a site politely; for the sitemap URLs themselves use sitemap. Example: url=https://www.google.com/search. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

agent.description: Crawler user agent or product token (default *)

url.description: The page URL to check (its site's /robots.txt is read)
